statement: NVIDIA said memory scarcity is driven in large part by the AI build-out itself and that the magnitude of the memory price increase has exceeded its prior expectations, with prices headed even higher into next year.
why: The buyer of last resort for HBM is telling investors memory prices are running past its own forecasts, which points to tight memory supply persisting through next year.

impact.mechanism: Memory scarcity raises accelerator bill-of-materials cost and caps how many systems can be built regardless of order book.

evidence.source: BigGo Finance (citing NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
evidence.excerpt: the magnitude of the price increase has exceeded our prior expectations and are headed even higher into next year.

confidence.basis: Management quote relayed by a single secondary outlet; no primary transcript read.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> rising); sources: BigGo Finance (citing NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call), Digitimes (headline/lede, paywalled beyond)
